program_or_activity: Risk Management Agency Federal Crop Insurance Corporation

fy2024_payment_universe_evidence.com_23_001_document_scope: all applicable policyholder and Approved Insurance Provider documentation for the 326 statistically selected policies is submitted through CARS

excluded_oig_table_value.reason: The OIG-hosted report's unaudited table value conflicts with the authoritative PaymentAccuracy annual workbook and appears to be a typographical error; it must not be used.

methodology_field_decision.basis: The FCIC/RMA FY2024 report explicitly says the rate considers all payment categories and enumerates premium subsidy, A&O expense, and indemnities. COM-23-001 independently confirms that all applicable policyholder and AIP documentation for the sampled policies is submitted through CARS.

evidence_boundaries: The payment-universe closure is limited to the reported inclusion of all three payment-category classes in the improper-payment rate.

AIP tier names and annual statistical-validity language do not disclose frame construction, tier allocation, selection probabilities, randomization details, weights, projection estimator, or variance method; sample design and estimation method remain open.
The sources do not publish policy-level exclusions or review exclusions; exclusion rules remain open.
The Payment Integrity section on printed pages 60-61 is explicitly Other Information (Unaudited), and the page-18 discussion is also unaudited management discussion and analysis.
The apparent 579.93 million overpayment table typo is excluded; the authoritative annual workbook value remains 573.93 million.
Nothing in these sources establishes identified debt, collectible dollars, collections, recoveries, preventable loss, control cost, or savings.
